rationale: The OE BÓT here means 'remedy, compensation, amends, reparation' (cf. Latin compensatio, emendatio, reparatio, oblatio), a legal/penitential sense of making good or atoning for a wrong. This is entirely distinct from all offered synsets, which relate to the footwear or torture device called "boot." No candidate synset captures the sense of compensatory payment or remedy.
